When enabled, Social AI Keyboard uses Android Accessibility to read visible conversational text in supported apps so it can prepare reply suggestions. Conversation history is stored only on this device in encrypted form. In Managed AI mode, relevant text is sent through the Social AI Assistant Pro Cloudflare backend, where subscription, quota, device proof and server-side training rules are enforced; in Personal API mode, relevant text is sent to OpenRouter with your own key. Photo Caption sends only images you explicitly select, after local JPEG re-encoding that strips original EXIF/GPS metadata. Passwords, PINs, OTPs, payment/card and other sensitive fields are blocked. The app never presses Send or posts for you.

Social AI Keyboard can read visible conversational text only after you affirmatively enable AI Context Access. Visible conversation text and locally collected conversation history are used to prepare reply suggestions. Conversation history is stored only on this device and message bodies are encrypted at rest. In Managed AI mode, requested social context is sent to the Social AI Assistant Pro Cloudflare backend. The backend enforces login, subscription, quota, one-account/one-active-device rules, cryptographic Device Proof, replay/rate limits, and server Training Center rules before contacting its configured AI provider. In Personal API mode, requested text is sent directly to OpenRouter using your encrypted local key. Photo Caption sends at most four images only after your explicit action; each local image is re-encoded as JPEG, resized, and transmitted without the original EXIF/GPS metadata, and is not stored in the app database. Optional personal typing learning stores bounded word, word-pair, and phonetic-pair counts only on this device; it can be disabled or cleared from Keyboard Preferences and is never mixed with AI training. Passwords, PINs, OTPs, payment/card fields, banking-sensitive fields, and other protected fields are blocked from AI context reading. The Accessibility service cannot perform gestures and never presses Send. Generated text is inserted only after your action, and sending/posting remains your action in the app you are using. You can disable AI Context Access, logout, remove your personal API key, and clear locally stored conversation history at any time.
This permanently removes locally stored conversation history from this device. It does not remove your API key or disable the keyboard.
